Name: Crop Traits
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791754385-468424620.png[/img]
[font=Arial]Crop Traits is a mod that adds over 120 gameplay changing traits to crops. Traits appear through random mutations and can be kept through seeds or spliced together into rare combinations.[/font]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791759506-993648833.png[/img]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791754380-759707351.png[/img]
[font=Arial]To get started with Crop Traits, you will need to first discover a trait via a crop mutation (which occur randomly when the crop first sprouts) or reach level 3 farming. The next day after, Demetrius will send you a letter containing a helpful guidebook that covers all of the mod's details.[/font]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791755853-485220725.png[/img]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791756071-1834608700.gif[/img]
Mutations can be spotted by looking for a sparkle effect, which appears on crops with new mutations that have not been harvested yet. Crops with traits can also be spotted by pressing [b]G[/b], which will mark the crop with an icon (see left side of the above image). This keybind can be changed in the [b]config.json[/b].

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791756415-1811191379.gif[/img]
Mutations can rarely inherit traits from nearby crops of the same type. You can also use the Seed Splicer, craftable from farming level 9, to more reliably mix traits.

You can use the Seed Mixer to propagate your current traits by feeding it any hybrid crop, which will give you seeds with the same traits. The Seed Maker is craftable from farming level 3 (down from vanilla's level 9 requirement).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791755192-1041043089.png[/img]
[font=Arial]Simply use the guidebook to open it. If you prefer not to use an item to see the UI, assign a keybind in [b]config.json[/b].[/font]

[font=Arial]If you ever lose your guidebook, another one can be purchased for free from Pierre's shop (after it has first been unlocked).[/font]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791828161-478399924.gif[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53759/53759-1791755652-1601358160.png[/img]
Traits are intended to be discovered as you find them. However, if you would like to know all the details beforehand, simply enable the "Show undiscovered traits" option within the guidebook's settings.

[font=Arial]Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/StardewSandbox/tree/mods/crop-traits]available here[/url].[/font]
